# Flow: add a dependency link (U blocks X)
Load when: decision row 5 of SKILL.md (an activity X waits for another activity U)

## Preconditions
1. Which tool per scope, and why a link and not a context: [link-or-context-or-thread](link-or-context-or-thread.md).
2. `upstreamProjectId` = projectId unless the user or the summary says otherwise (SKILL.md §3).
3. No create tool checks issue existence, duplicates, self-links or same-project cycles: steps 1–3 and the list reads below are the only guard.
4. No tool in this flow takes `idempotencyKey`: `create_issue_link`, `create_workspace_issue_link`, `create_portfolio_work_item_link`, `set_project_issue_blocker_context`. Never pass one; re-read the step's list before any retry.

## Steps
### P2 Link U blocks X — row 5
1. Ids: the user gave ids → use them. Else `list_issues`(projectId, limitCount=100; cursor=`nextCursor` until null) → `items[].id` where `title` matches exactly; for U call it with upstreamProjectId. 0 or 2+ matches → Stop and ask. Never guess an id.
2. `get_issue`(projectId, X) → "Issue not found", `isDeleted:true`, or `status` `done`/`canceled` → STOP "X is not an open activity".
3. `get_issue`(upstreamProjectId, U) → `status` `done`/`canceled` or `isDeleted:true` → STOP "U is finished"; "Issue not found" → ask for U.
4. Scope: upstreamProjectId == projectId → step 5; upstreamProjectId in `list_workspace_projects`(workspaceId) → `id` → step 6; else → step 7 (other workspace).
5. Same project: `list_issue_links`(projectId) → `blocks` U→X exists → report it, STOP; reverse X→U (or legacy `is-blocked-by` U→X) → Stop and ask; none → `create_issue_link`(projectId, sourceIssueId=U, targetIssueId=X, type="blocks") [A] (no idempotencyKey).
6. Other project: `list_workspace_issue_links`(workspaceId, sourceProjectId=upstreamProjectId) → U→X exists → report it, STOP; `list_workspace_issue_links`(workspaceId, sourceProjectId=projectId) → X→U exists → Stop and ask; none → `create_workspace_issue_link`(workspaceId, sourceProjectId=upstreamProjectId, sourceIssueId=U, targetProjectId=projectId, targetIssueId=X, type="blocks") [A] (no idempotencyKey).
7. Other workspace: `list_portfolio_work_item_links`(workspaceId, projectId, status="active") → U→X exists → report it, STOP; X→U → Stop and ask; none → SKILL.md §6 confirmation → `create_portfolio_work_item_link`(source={workspaceId=otherWorkspaceId, projectId=upstreamProjectId, issueId=U, visibleSummary=<confirmed text>}, target={workspaceId, projectId, issueId=X, visibleSummary=<confirmed text>}, type="blocks", rationale) [C] (no idempotencyKey) → linkId from the text result.
8. After step 7: SKILL.md P3 with blockerContext="Blocked by portfolio link <linkId>: <U> in <otherWorkspaceId> — owner of <U> — since <date>". Without it the block never shows in `list_blocked_project_issues`.
9. Verify (below). A failed verify is never a reason to create again: re-read the step's list first (no server dedupe, no idempotencyKey).

## Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| reverse link X blocks U exists | "Which must finish first: <A> or <B>?" (a link both ways deadlocks both) |
| step 7, before the create | "Link <U> blocks <X>, summary '<≤240 chars, seen by both>'?" — the confirmed text is `visibleSummary`; no confidential text |
| U or X matches 0 or 2+ activities (step 1) | "Which activity is '<title>'?" then each match as `<id>: <title>`, one per line (none → "No activity titled '<title>' in <projectId>; send its id.") |

## Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| `create_issue_link` | `list_issue_links`(projectId) + `list_blocked_project_issues`(projectId) | linkId present; X listed with "Bloqueado por" U |
| `create_workspace_issue_link` | `list_workspace_issue_links`(workspaceId, sourceProjectId=upstreamProjectId) + `get_project_dependency_summary`(projectId) | linkId present; `criticalBlockers[]` has X. `list_blocked_project_issues` never shows cross-project links |
| `create_portfolio_work_item_link` | `list_portfolio_work_item_links`(workspaceId, projectId, status="active") + `get_issue`(projectId, X) | linkId present; `blockerContext.status == "active"` naming the linkId |

## Report fields
Scope (same project / other project / other workspace), U → X, linkId, the list call that proved it, blocker context (step 8), Pending, Next.
Next, same project or other project: "Finish U; the block ends by itself when U is `done`/`canceled`." Never say the link must be resolved, closed or removed (row 9 only posts release comments).
Next, other workspace: "When U is done, close link <linkId> and resolve the context (SKILL.md row 10)."
